tools.name: find_makeables
tools.description: Search what Unfactory can make, from a plain description of what the person wants (e.g. 'something to hold my phone while I cook'). Returns matching items with sizes, colours, prices and making time.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Price one item with chosen options, delivered to a Nigerian state. Returns a quote_id valid for 24 hours, the total in naira (including delivery) and the arrival day. Show this to the person before ordering.

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: Only call after the person has seen the quote and said yes. Creates the order and sends a 6-digit code to their phone by WhatsApp or SMS. Then ask them for the code and call confirm_order.

tools.name: confirm_order
tools.description: Confirm an order using the 6-digit code the person received. Use exactly the code they give you.

tools.name: track_order
tools.description: Get the status and history of an order. Needs the order id and the phone number it was placed with.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel an order before making starts. Needs the order id and the phone number it was placed with. Only do this if the person asks.

tools.name: start_three_wishes
tools.description: Begin a founding member's wishes. Sends a 6-digit code to their phone (any country; country code needed outside Nigeria). Then ask them for it and call verify_wisher.

tools.name: verify_wisher
tools.description: Check the code the person received. Returns a wish_token for make_wish and my_wishes, their founding number, which wishes they have, their place in line and their invite link. Use exactly the code they give you. If someone invited them, pass that invite code.

tools.name: make_wish
tools.description: Save one of the person's three founding wishes. slot 1: made for them by you, sealed; it can be from their list of ten or something else (needs reason). slot 2: for someone they love (needs recipient_name, recipient_phone, recipient_city, giver_name, recipient_note). slot 3: their own pick. tools.name: my_wishes
tools.description: Shows their founding wishes (wish one stays sealed), their wish list, their discounts, place in line, friends who joined and invite link.

tools.name: add_wishes
tools.description: Save up to ten wishes to the person's wish list: their list of ten (source "list"), things they ask for (source "added"), or something you noticed and they agreed to (source "ai_suggested"). tools.name: most_wished
tools.description: The things Unfactory members wish for most, and whether they can be made yet. Wishes many people share get made first.
